integrity: Proof includes the exact stationary product transform, limiting dilogarithmic pressure, local exponential-tilt and tightness LDP proof, and reproducible finite checks. No outside certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-dimensional Brownian particles with identical Poisson common multiplicative resets, weak contraction s down to zero and threshold L/sqrt(s); not uniform in particle number or arbitrary reset environments.
title: Dilogarithmic rare-excursion law for a Brownian gas with frequent weak common resetting
